name: [DevOps & DB] W06 — PostgreSQL Performans, Önbellek & Şişme Nöbetçisi

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active') as active_connections,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type IS NOT NULL) as waiting_locks,
  (SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))) as database_size,
  (SELECT round(sum(blks_hit) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(blks_hit + blks_read), 0), 2) FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()) as cache_hit_ratio,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(n_dead_tup), 0) FROM pg_stat_user_tables) as dead_tuples_total,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM "Lead" WHERE "createdAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as new_leads_24h;
